lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-grid formation posterior to the gill slits, with a notable triplet forming an isosceles triangle at the mid-flank centroid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary blobs, forming a discernible rectilinear grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp pixel intensity gradient where the upper edge is significantly brighter than the shadowed lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits approximately 6-8 high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily along the lower two-thirds of the fin's macro-mask.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of numerous elongated, high-chroma red pixel clusters across the flank and dorsal fin, consistent with ectoparasitic attachment; no large-scale tissue loss or structural scarring visible.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced transition from high-density, small-diameter spots on the rostrum/head region to larger, widely spaced blobs on the posterior flank.
